title: ClipMax Highlight Analysis
description: The exact JSON object the highlight-detection LLM must return. The worker validates every response against this schema before writing clip rows. Duration bounds (30-60s), word-boundary snapping, and overlap de-duplication are enforced in code because JSON Schema cannot express them cleanly.

start_seconds.description: Inclusive start of the clip in the source video.

end_seconds.description: Exclusive end of the clip in the source video.

title.description: Internal working title, not the on-screen hook.

hook_text.description: Short overlay line rendered at the top of the clip.

virality_score.description: Engagement score from emotional payoff, topic clarity, and pacing.

reasoning.description: Why this moment works. Shown in the clip card details.

quote.description: Optional verbatim excerpt used for review and QA.
